title: An Nvidia insider-turned-VC on why robotics hasn’t hit its ChatGPT moment, yet
slides: Why hasn't robotics had its ChatGPT moment?
A former Nvidia insider turned VC explains the gap.
Unlike language, robots struggle with messy physical data.
Investors now back startups solving real-world tasks.
Pick one repetitive task and measure robot ROI.
thread_text:
1. Why No Robot ChatGPT?

A former Nvidia insider turned VC says the gap isn't software—it's that robots can't learn from text alone. They need to touch, fail, and retry in the real world.

2. The Physical Data Problem

Unlike language models that train on billions of clean sentences, robots face messy, unpredictable physical data. Every grasp is different. That's the bottleneck.

3. Investors Bet On Tasks

VCs are now funding startups that solve one real-world job—like bin picking or floor scrubbing—instead of chasing a general-purpose humanoid.

4. One Task, One ROI

Pick a single repetitive task in your warehouse or lab. Measure how long a robot takes versus a human. The math often surprises people.

5. Test It Yourself

Take one boring task you do weekly. Estimate the cost of a robot that does it 80% as well. Does the ROI still hold? Run the numbers this week.
